build_bond_length_matrix: build a bond length and type matrix from an RDKit molecule using covalent and van der Waals radii
create_torsional_data: create torsional data including positions, torsion indices, and edge masks from an RDKit molecule and energy model
generate_homogeneous_dataset: generate a homogeneous PyTorch Geometric dataset from a SMILES string with optional torsion learning and relaxation
load_spice_dataset: load and cache a SPICE dataset from a file path with parallel SMILES processing and optional torsion learning
convert_xyz_to_loader: convert an XYZ file and SMILES string into a PyTorch Geometric DataLoader for molecular graph data
